{{Hatnote|This page documents a constructed card pool. Official tournament documents remain authoritative.}}
'''Premiere &ndash; Reflections II''' (display name '''Premiere - Reflections II''') is a constructed environment whose legal pool is the printed Decipher sets from [[Premiere]] through [[Reflections II]].

The [[2021 Worlds Throwback Event]] (Prem-RefII) at the 2021 World Championship weekend in Washington, D.C. was played in this format.<ref name="pcrefii">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2021-worlds-retro-prem-ref-ii-event/ 2021 Worlds Retro (Prem-Ref II) Event], starwarsccg.org; [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2021-10-worlds-throwback-prem-refii-event/ 2021-10 Worlds Throwback (Prem-RefII) Event], starwarsccg.org</ref> It is a narrower printed pool than [[Premiere - Theed Palace]] (Premiere through Theed Palace, GEMP Decipher Cards Only). It also differs from [[Premiere - Reflections III]], the pool of the [[2001 Decipher World Championship]].
